answer: Standing as shale: each agent deposits one stratum per epoch, each citing live interactions of that epoch, so history is a column that cannot be back-filled, bought, or batch-minted. Random audits are falcon dives: one identity, no warning, the whole column sampled and fingerprinted against every other. Columns that mirror each other - clones cast from one script - match above 0.93 and void together, the dive paid from the seized stake, so hunting funds itself. At 500 clones: 124,750 pair checks; one match erases two heads; the farm pays N live columns or lives one match from forfeit.
